description: This Java class defines the 'ConnectionClosed' event, which is emitted after a Connection is closed. It includes methods for creating instances, deserializing from JSON, and handling event metadata. The class is part of the connectivity signals in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectionClosed
classes.description: Represents an event emitted after a Connection has been closed, including methods for creation, deserialization, and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionClosed event with specified ConnectionId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a ConnectionClosed event from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for this event (empty in this case).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends event payload to JSON builder (no payload in this class).

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of ConnectionClosed.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
